EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Source, whose access derives from routine duties in the Ostrand Peninsula, stated that a patrol reports a darkened contact not correlating with any AIS track.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Sarn (P-121).

3. Source noted that instructions were passed verbally rather than through the usual written schedule, which source considered unusual.

4. Source observed 8 covered loads on the apron and was unable to identify type. Source's estimate derives from the length of the covered line at a range of some 600 metres in poor light.

5. Source placed the activity between 2021Z and 1920Z, and was able to observe for approximately 45 minutes before withdrawing.

6. Source was not tasked against this activity and could not answer follow-up questions before reporting.
